client.name: Elaine Tan
client.background: Elaine Tan is a private-banking client who reviews her portfolio herself but prefers assistance with transaction administration.
client.investment_objective: Reduce exposure to emerging-market debt and make the portfolio less sensitive to credit-market stress.
client.loss_attitude: Elaine is hesitant about crystallising losses and uncomfortable describing herself as highly loss-tolerant. She is nevertheless willing to accept a realised loss when reducing an exposure she no longer wants.

setting.call_reason: Elaine calls to arrange a reduction of her existing bond-fund holding after reviewing the exposures in her portfolio.
setting.conversation_style: A brief, practical Singapore-English telephone conversation. Elaine uses shorthand references to portfolio items and becomes tentative when discussing losses.

final_product.description: Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund invests in emerging-market debt and is the holding selected for the final sale.
concrete_risks: Deterioration in emerging-market issuers' credit quality or a default can reduce the value of the fund's bond holdings.
Rising interest rates can depress the market value of bonds held by the fund.
Thin liquidity in emerging-market debt during stressed conditions can make disposal difficult and adversely affect the fund's valuation.
final_product.recommendation_basis: Reducing this holding lowers the client's exposure to emerging-market credit deterioration and stressed debt-market liquidity, consistent with her preference for a less credit-sensitive portfolio.

other_products.description: Meridian Asia Equity Fund is an equity fund focused on Asian markets, mentioned only as a separate portfolio-review candidate rather than the selected transaction.

parsed_response.holding_context: Elaine already holds Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund in her portfolio and wants to reduce that existing position.

edge_case_context.motivation: Elaine reviews the bond fund before mentioning the equity fund as a separate portfolio item. She then refers back to the bond holding by its earlier description because she assumes the distinction is clear, rather than repeating its full name.

additional_discussion_topics: The client's preference for telephone contact
